name: popover

native.scope: Native declaration, admitted child content, and browser lifecycle integration are not yet verified.

summary: Reveals brief contextual information in a native details disclosure, optionally enhanced with dismissal and collision positioning.

agent.useWhen: Brief supporting information belongs next to its trigger and can remain available in native disclosure semantics.
agent.avoidWhen: The content is essential task content, needs protected focus, or contains a complex workflow.

contract.role: native details and summary contextual disclosure
invariants: The native details/summary disclosure works without JavaScript; no ARIA state is recreated.
Content is supplied only through a separately host-admitted slot; icon names use the package's closed geometry catalog.
Enhanced Escape/outside dismissal and viewport collision positioning do not replace native disclosure behavior.
The panel id is the sole derived id and must be reserved against page collisions.
Adapter fragment has exactly one [[popover]] slot.
